alerts.summary: A software deployment matches an approved maintenance change.
A device's security agent stopped sending health events outside maintenance.
Privileged account activity occurred after the account owner confirmed it was unexpected.
A service account completed its scheduled credential rotation.
A backup monitor reported a planned exercise documented in the change calendar.
Several records corroborate unexpected access to a restricted document collection.
A duplicate availability notification matches a resolved infrastructure incident.
A new endpoint identifier is associated with an unapproved privileged login.
